# International Insurance

> > International Insurance provides global medical coverage and international health insurance solutions, specializing in GeoBlue Navigator plans for students, missionaries, and travelers through Blue Cross Blue Shield Worldwide Specialty networks.

The site focuses on helping individuals and families secure comprehensive international health insurance coverage with access to worldwide medical networks. Primary offerings include GeoBlue Navigator plans backed by Blue Cross Blue Shield Global Solutions for various traveler types including students studying abroad and missionaries working internationally.
